text: Artificial intelligence (AI) is a branch of computer science that creates machines able to perform tasks that normally require human intelligence. Machine learning is a key part of AI. Instead of following fixed rules, computers learn from data and improve with experience. Deep learning is a more advanced form of machine learning. It uses artificial neural networks with many layers to recognise images, speech, and patterns. Today, AI is part of our daily lives. We use it in voice assistants, search engines, social media, online shopping, and navigation apps. AI also helps doctors, scientists, and businesses make faster and smarter decisions.
